intervals.label: collaboration (project started 2003)
intervals.note: Start is the date the project began; the collaboration's formation date is not published in the sources read. Open: the IDM 2026 contribution is by the collaboration (S. Higashino).
intervals.quote: We started a new project, NEw generation WIMP-search with Advanced Gaseous tracking device Experiment (NEWAGE) in 2003

name: NEWAGE Collaboration
notes: Roster and leadership not published in the sources read. The abbreviation 'NEWAGE Collaboration' is used by other collaborations' citations (e.g. arXiv:1012.3912 cites 'K. Miuchi et al. (NEWAGE Collaboration)').

summary.plain: The Japanese research team (Kobe University, Kyoto University and the Kamioka Observatory, among others) that builds and runs the NEWAGE direction-sensitive dark matter detectors in the Kamioka mine.
summary.technical: NEWAGE (NEw generation WIMP search with an Advanced Gaseous tracking device Experiment) group: authors from Kobe University, Kyoto University, Tohoku University, Waseda University, Tokyo University of Science and the Kamioka Observatory (ICRR) / Kavli IPMU, per the affiliations of arXiv:2301.04779. No roster is published in the sources read.
